facts.fact: DCNN reports LINX Nairobi, launched November 2023, is operating with local ISPs (ICON Fiber, Mtaani Telecom, Mymanga Networks, PepeaNet), global content networks and partners interconnected and traffic starting to build; no figure given.
DCNN reports global content networks such as Meta are present at LINX Nairobi, peering with local ISPs.

note: Fourth-site PAIX extension is about to go live, not yet in service.
